title: Lazy Slovakian Pork Kebabs
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired dish featuring juicy pork, served on a platter with a side of kabanos.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread pork cubes, onion, and garlic onto skewers.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until pork is cooked through to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, grill kabanos for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Serve pork skewers on a platter with kabanos and garnish with parsley.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
